name: Gallery Pass
description: Public seat 41, third reading, 2064. Numbered, dated, and issued to somebody who did not come.

name: Board Seal
description: A pressed seal from the Continuity Board. Four names on the ring and a fifth line that has been left deliberately blank since 2091.

name: The Enabling Act
description: Eleven pages. Creates in law the category of perpetual administrative counterparty, which is the legal shape of a thing that can be owned forever.
